jurisdiction.name: Venezuela
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Venezuela has no AI law and no data protection law. Its AI governance rests on the science and technology ministry's (MINCYT) non-binding Code of Ethics for the Responsible Development and Application of AI, launched in February 2026. An AI bill has been pending since its first discussion in November 2024, and a National AI Plan has been announced, but no plan document was found.
lead_institutions: Ministerio del Poder Popular para Ciencia y Tecnología (MINCYT)
narrative.review_notes: This review was carried out on 12 October 2026. The Supreme Court's gazette portal, the National Printing Office, the central bank and the National Assembly's bill pages could not be accessed, so the AI bill's text and status could not be read; the official gazette's own search was used instead. Venezuela is marked for a later retry and, as a country of over 20 million people with few records, for a longer catch-up pass. The AI bill, the National AI Plan and new AI vice-ministries are tracked as leads.

instruments.official_title: Código de Ética para el Desarrollo y Aplicación Responsable de la Inteligencia Artificial
instruments.english_title: Code of Ethics for the Responsible Development and Application of Artificial Intelligence
instruments.issuing_authority: Ministry of Popular Power for Science and Technology (MINCYT), General Directorate for the Development and Application of Artificial Intelligence (DGDAIA), Vice-Ministry for the Development of Information and Communication Technologies
instruments.current_status: Presented by the Minister of Science and Technology on 19 February 2026 (MINCYT launch notice, which invites scientific and academic actors to adopt it and links the PDF). The document itself carries no date, resolution number or Gaceta Oficial reference, and no Gaceta publication was found; it is treated as non-binding ministerial guidance. A MINCYT notice of 29 September 2026 quotes the vice-minister saying the country has had the code 'since 2024', which conflicts with the launch notice; the launch date is used here (the text itself cites the AI bill's first discussion of 19 November 2024). It is described by MINCYT as one of three pillars alongside the pending AI bill and a National AI Plan (see leads).
instruments.summary: Ethics code drafted by MINCYT's General Directorate for the Development and Application of AI that sets nine guiding principles for AI in Venezuela: humanist AI, equity and non-discrimination, environmental responsibility, security, privacy, transparency, accountability, open science and excellence. It addresses everyone involved in AI research, development, innovation and application, and AI users, and expects among other things consent for data use by AI systems, auditable and explainable models, human oversight with final human responsibility, and avoidance of mass surveillance, manipulation and profiling that segments people. It also reviews the national legal framework (Constitution, Science, Technology and Innovation Law, Infogobierno Law) and international references such as the UNESCO Recommendation.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Venezuela's only published national AI-specific governance document; the reference ethical framework pending an AI law.

leads.title: Proyecto de Ley de Inteligencia Artificial
leads.note: Pending bill. Approved at first discussion on 19 November 2024 (date stated in MINCYT's AI ethics code, p. 7). Reported by MINCYT on 8 January 2026 as still under debate in the National Assembly; on 16 April 2026 MINCYT announced a 'Ley Nacional para el Desarrollo y Uso Ético de la Inteligencia Artificial' would be submitted to the Assembly (https://mincyt.gob.ve/mincyt-impulsa-seis-proyectos-de-ley-estrategicos-para-fortalecer-la-ciencia-tecnologia-y-transformacion-digital-de-venezuela/). No bill text on asambleanacional.gob.ve (bill pages and searches not public / blocked) and no sanction in the Gaceta Oficial found as of 12 October 2026. Record once sanctioned and published.

leads.english_title: Decree No. 5,363 creating the Vice-Ministry for Information Systematization and Artificial Intelligence Applied to Planning (Ministry of Planning)
leads.note: Official gazette text read (http://www.gacetaoficial.gob.ve/storage/2026/43401-2026-06-19-ORDINARIA.pdf). Art. 2 creates a vice-ministry within the Ministry of Planning to order information sources and databases using AI for the planning system; an internal organizational instrument for one ministry's use of AI, not an instrument governing AI. Kept as a lead.
